description: Na₃Cu₅O₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.60 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.43 Å. There are five inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (1.87 Å) Cu-O bond length. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and one longer (1.88 Å) Cu-O bond length. In the third Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.87 Å) and one longer (1.89 Å) Cu-O bond length. In the fourth Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. Both Cu-O bond lengths are 1.85 Å. In the fifth Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.87 Å) Cu-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Cu atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Cu atoms to form corner-sharing ONa₂Cu₃ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-68°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Cu atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Cu atoms to form distorted ONa₄Cu₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Cu₃ trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Cu₂ octahedra.
